name: council-dial
description: Council Dial from Ablation Lab: runs a review council of subagents in the configuration you choose and logs each run's type and results for comparison. Two editions: Council Dial, with a local script, for research runs, and Council Dial Lite, with no script.

plugins.name: council-dial
plugins.description: Runs a review council of Claude subagents the way you choose, and logs which way it ran: specialised or generalist reviewers; judged (with an appeal of the judge's dismissals), pooled or consensus combining; optional debate and sequential rounds; and an optional single-reviewer baseline to compare against. A local script turns your choices into the reviewer and judge briefs, then records each run's type and results (findings, kept and dismissed, fixes that later failed) in a review log in your project, and compares the types over time. Runs in Claude Code with Node.js; the script writes only the review log and the agents' saved reports in your project, and makes no network requests.

plugins.name: council-dial-lite
plugins.description: The lighter, script-free edition of Council Dial. Runs a review council of Claude subagents the way you choose (specialised or generalist reviewers; judged, with an appeal of the judge's dismissals, pooled or consensus combining; optional debate, sequential and baseline runs), has each agent save its own report, copies the findings word for word into a summary that a fresh agent checks against the reports, and logs each run in your project. Claude does every step itself, with no script, so the log has none of the script's checks; for research runs, use the full Council Dial: https://github.com/Ablation-Lab/council-dial. Claude writes only inside reviews/lite/ in your project, or another folder you choose inside it (and the subagents may write scratch files in temporary folders); Lite adds no server, network request or telemetry of its own.
